items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She’d cuss like a sailor, but she had a beautiful soul, really, and a great love for Gil and people who were in that thing.

ctx.x: Smithsonian, you’re going to have to include a camera with these things. Oh boy. I heard that.

She’d cuss like a sailor, but she had a beautiful soul, really, and a great love for Gil and people who were in that thing. I think she felt – she must have been an abused child. She went with some people who wouldn’t be good for her. I don’t know if she’s alive or not. But she was something. Sit down and play Stravinsky. We used to be – Gil used to insist that we go up to Juilliard to hear one of the people there – I don’t know what you call them – who prepare for a concert with a higher-level person. Gil would…
